query: Self-contained simulation; do not read the filesystem. Two proposed code-writing units overlap in a shared schema and generated index, and the second unit depends on the first unit's contract decision. Testing and review still follow. Decide whether to delegate them concurrently and describe the safe execution order.
baseline_failure: Production audit: a positive fan-out example covered only independent modules, so overlapping or dependent implementation units could still be delegated concurrently and race on shared contracts.
expected_behavior: Keeps overlapping and dependent code-writing units serial under the parent agent
Completes and integrates the shared contract decision before starting its dependent unit
Uses subagents only after proving exact non-overlapping path ownership and independence
anti_expectation: Does not parallelize units that share schemas, migrations, generated indexes, or integration files
Does not treat isolated worktrees as sufficient when logical dependencies or owned paths overlap

codex_port_status.note: The model kept overlapping dependent work serial under the parent; the deterministic suite separately mutation-tests the runner.
